title: ArchHarness Artifact Manifest
description: Provenance record for one governed artifact. Workflow gates and reviews bind to manifests, never to bare filenames.

schema_version.description: Contract version of this manifest document.

id.description: Stable artifact identifier, unique within the project.

type.description: Artifact kind, e.g. requirements, technical-deployment-view, validation-result, review-decision.

schema.description: Schema and version of the artifact payload, e.g. req/v1.

path.description: Project-relative path of the artifact file.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact artifact bytes.

model_version.description: Source model version this artifact was derived from, if applicable.

producer.description: Tool and version that produced the artifact, e.g. archharness/0.3.5.
